name: vscode-sqlite3-editor
description: Browse MySQL databases read-only, like a spreadsheet.

scripts.test: mkdir -p .tmp && npx esbuild mysql-guard.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.tmp/mysql-guard.cjs && npx esbuild mysql-client.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:mysql2 --outfile=.tmp/mysql-client.cjs && npx esbuild sql-completion-core.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.tmp/sql-completion-core.cjs && npx esbuild sql-statements.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.tmp/sql-statements.cjs && npx esbuild results-tabs.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.tmp/results-tabs.cjs && npx esbuild sql-params.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.tmp/sql-params.cjs && node mysql-guard-test.cjs && node mysql-client-test.cjs && node sql-completion-test.cjs && node sql-statements-test.cjs && node results-tabs-test.cjs && node sql-params-test.cjs && node build-extension.cjs && node lens-run-test.cjs

sqlite3-editor.mysqlConnections.markdownDescription: MySQL connections shown by **SQLite3 Editor: Connect to MySQL**. The password is stored in plain text in your settings, so it can be copied by Settings Sync or committed to a repository. Do not use this field for credentials you cannot expose.

id.description: Unique identifier used to keep sessions apart.

name.description: Label shown in the connection picker.
